_comment: ED-026 cutover-completeness allowlist. The legit places where a deleted-old-tree path literal or a renamed-away role name MAY appear as live (non-comment, non-`was:`) content. Enforced by scripts/checks/cutover-completeness.js. Keep SMALL — comment refs and `was:` fields are auto-allowed by the gate, so an entry here is only for a FUNCTIONAL ref that is sanctioned. `files` = exact repo-relative path (forward slashes); `prefixes` = repo-relative path prefix. Each value is the REASON (required). A stale entry (matches no literal) is surfaced as a note.

files.scripts/checks/cutover-completeness.js: The detector itself — it MUST name every dead-tree literal + renamed-away role in its DEAD_TREE/DEAD_ROLES needle tables. Self-reference, not stale residue.
files.scripts/checks/cutover-completeness.allo: This allowlist — its reason strings quote the old literals (e.g. the dispatch-agent LEGACY_TREE array) to explain WHY each exception exists. Self-reference.
files.scripts/hooks/lib/role-aliases.js: The back-compat alias table itself — it MUST name the old role names (evaluator/auditor + the ADR-0007 1:1 renames) to map them to canonical. Flagging it would be self-defeating.
files.scripts/dispatch-agent.js: The cutover-coexistence shim: LEGACY_TREE = ['00-alex','01-adhoc','02-oneshot','03-managers'] is named BY DESIGN so a stale duplicate spec under the old tree can't shadow the canonical new spec during the migration window. The resolver PREFERS NEW_TREE; the old names are the de-prioritization list, not a live path it depends on existing.
files.scripts/mc/manifest/test-bootstrap.js: A manifest-bootstrap test that WRITES a synthetic `framework/agents/00-alex/alpha.md` source fixture (makeCanonicalSourceFixture) to exercise the codemod — deliberately-old-tree SYNTHETIC input, not a real path the tool depends on. Doesn't end in .test.js (so the auto test-exclusion misses it); allowlisted explicitly.
A frozen one-time _docs→_requirements codemod whose SKIP_PATH_SUBSTRINGS defensively names the pre-cutover transient paths (02-oneshot/.system/retros + store.json) to NOT rewrite them. It's a substring skip-FILTER (never opens the path → no ENOENT risk); the entries are inert post-cutover residue, not a live dependency.
files.scripts/checks/doc-ref-integrity.allowli: The S-13b doc-ref-integrity allowlist — its `pathPrefixes` MUST name the removed-by-design dead-tree paths (.claude/agents/00-alex|01-adhoc|02-oneshot|03-managers/ + .system) so a doc citing one of them (a historical/migration description) is suppressed there rather than flagged as a broken nav-ref. cutover-completeness guards the LIVE-CODE layer; this file guards the DOC layer; each names the dead tree for its own correct reason (enforcer-doc-self-trip class). Self-reference, not stale residue.

prefixes.framework/releases/: Frozen shipped release capsules — immutable artifacts of a prior MC version; they correctly carry the tree shape that was current when they shipped. Never rewrite a frozen capsule.
prefixes..claude/agents/president/_system/policy/: The ADR-0007 decision record (and sibling ADRs) documents the cutover — it NAMES the old tree + old role names as the 'from' side of the rewrite. That is its job. (D-2: dir de-dotted .system→_system 2026-06-08.)
